transfers.dispatch_hint: Iyo bohereje, bikurwa mu duka bivamo gusa — igiteranyo cy’isosiyete ntigihinduka kugeza byakiriwe.
transfers.partial_hint: Wemerewe kwakira igice: andika ingano yakiriwe kuri buri murongo.
transfers.company_stock_note: Kwimura ntibyongera cyangwa ngo bigabanye ububiko bw’isosiyete.
transfers.receive_lines_hint: Andika ingano yakiriwe (0 bisigare mu nzira):

inventory.opening_stock_hint: Ububiko bwo gutangira bwandikwa mu iduka risanzwe n'amateka yuzuye y'ingendo z'ibicuruzwa.

sales.title: Ubucuruzi n'Ibicuruzwa Byagurishijwe
sales.subtitle: Gukora inyandiko z'ibiciro (devis), komande, na fagitire z'ubucuruzi
sales.walk_in_hint: Nta zina ry’umukiriya rikenerwa; amafaranga yakirwa ako kanya. Kugurisha ku ideni bisaba umukiriya uzwi.
sales.credit_customer_hint: Kugurisha ku ideni bisaba umukiriya uzwi.
sales.base_total_note: Imibare y’ibaruramari ihindurwa mu ifaranga ry’ibanze hakurikijwe iki gipimo; igiteranyo n’igipimo by’umwimerere birabikwa.
sales.auto_post_hint: Ibyanditswe nk'ibyishyuwe: JENESIS yandika iyogurisha n'inyemezabwishyu nyayo ako kanya, igakuraho n'ububiko bw'iduka.
sales.settle_hint: Andika ubwishyu busigaye kandi werekane ko iyi nyandiko yishyuwe (F2).
sales.payment_on_creation_hint: Iyo kugurisha byandikwa nk'ibyishyuwe bifite inyemezabwishyu nyayo. Nta guhitamo BYISHYUWE/NTIBYISHYUWE.
sales.discard_message: Fagitire watangiye ntirabikwa. Gufunga iyi nyandiko birayisiba.
sales.duplicated_from: Bivanye kuri {number}. Reba ingano, hanyuma wemeze.

purchases.title: Ibyaguzwe n'Inyemezabwishyu z'Abagemura
purchases.subtitle: Gukurikirana ibyo isosiyete igura, komande zo kugura, no kwishyura
purchases.receipt_hint: Ububiko bwiyongera GUSA iyo inyandiko yo kwakira yinjiye — ntabwo bwiyongera ku gukora igicuruzwa, komande cyangwa fagitire.
purchases.settle_hint: Andika ubwishyu busigaye kandi werekane ko iyi fagitire yishyuwe (F2).
purchases.payment_on_creation_hint: Iyo fagitire yandikwa nk'iyishyuwe ifite ubwishyu nyabwo bw'uwaduhaye ibicuruzwa. Nta guhitamo BYISHYUWE/NTIBYISHYUWE.
purchases.discard_message: Fagitire watangiye ntirabikwa. Gufunga iyi nyandiko birayisiba.

banking.title: Ubwishyu, Amafaranga na Banki
banking.subtitle: Kese z'amafaranga, konti za banki, Mobile Money (MoMo) no koherereza
banking.explanation_hint: Ibisobanuro birasabwa iyo amafaranga abazwe atandukanye n’ayateganyijwe. Itandukaniro ntirihita ryandikwa mu ibaruramari.
banking.no_auto_adjust_note: Nta guhindura imibare y’ibaruramari byikora: itandukaniro ryandikwa mu nyandiko gusa kugira ngo ryemezwe n’undi wigenga.
banking.cash_hint: Kubara amafaranga mu bwoko bwabyo bigereranya ayo mu kese n’ayateganyijwe (yafunguwe + yinjiye − yasohotse by’igihe).
banking.reverse_confirm: Uremeza gukuraho ubu bwishyu? Inyandiko y’ibaruramari n’imibare yose bizasubizwa uko byari biri, kandi byandikwe mu mateka.
banking.approval_note: Wafunze igenzura ntashobora kuryemeza — hagomba kwemeza undi muntu wigenga.
banking.settle_fx_diff: Kwishyura inyandiko yose — shyira ikinyuranyo cy'ivunjisha mu bitabo
banking.settle_fx_hint: Ikinyuranyo hagati y'umusigane w'inyandiko n'ubu bwishyu mu faranga y'ibanze kigenda mu nyungu (4800) / igihombo (5900) cy'ivunjisha.

accounting.title: Ibaruramari Rusange n'Igitabo Kinini
accounting.subtitle: Uburyo bw'ibaruramari bushingiye ku mpande zombi (Debite na Kredite)
accounting.out_of_balance: Ikinyuranyo hagati ya Debite na Kredite ni

reports.title: Raporo z'Imari z'Ubucuruzi
reports.subtitle: Raporo z'igereranya ry'amakonti, inyungu n'igihombo, umutungo n'imyenda, n'imisoro
reports.balance_check: Kugenzura Ibaruramari: Umutungo = Imyenda + Imari Shingiro
reports.net_tax_payable: TVA Isigaye yo Kwishyura RRA / (TVA Yishyurwa Isosiyete)

settings.title: Ibyagenwe n'Ubuyobozi bwa Sisitemu
settings.subtitle: Amakuru y'isosiyete, abakozi bemerewe gukoresha sisitemu, imisoro no kubika kopi
settings.backup_desc: Kura kopi y'amakuru yose y'ibaruramari, ububiko n'inyemezabwishyu mu bubiko bwa mudasobwa yawe.
settings.restore_desc: Shyiramo idosiye ya kopi yemejwe kugira ngo ugarure amakuru.
settings.reset_demo_desc: Gusiba ibiriho byose ugasubizaho isosiyete y'urugero yuzuye ibaruramari ry'iteganywa.
settings.restore_invalid_file: Dosiye wahisemo ntabwo ari backup yemewe
settings.restore_warning: Gusubiza inyuma bisimbuza amakuru y'ubucuruzi y'iki kigo na backup. Reba neza ko wahisemo dosiye ikwiye.
settings.restore_signout_notice: Nyuma yo gusubiza inyuma, abakoresha bose basohoka kandi bagomba kongera kwinjira n'ijambobanga risanzwe.
settings.restore_done: Backup yasubijwe inyuma. Nyamuneka ongera winjire.
settings.require_goods_receipt_hint: Nibyemezwa, fagitire y’umugemura yinjizwa gusa ifitanye isano n’inyandiko yo kwakira yinjiye — ububiko ntabwo bwiyongera bidafite kwakira ku mugaragaro.
settings.valuation_hint: FIFO ikoresha ibiciro by’ibya mbere byaguzwe; impuzandengo (weighted average) ikoresha impuzandengo y’ibiciro igenda ihinduka.
settings.base_locked: Ifaranga y'ibanze ntishobora gukurwaho cyangwa guhagarikwa
settings.fx_revaluation: Kongera Kubara Ivunjisha ku Mpera y'Igihe
settings.fx_revaluation_hint: Ongera ubare factures n'ideni bifunguye mu faranga y'amahanga ku gipimo cy'ivunjisha cy'iyo tariki. Ikinyuranyo kitagezweho kijya muri konti 4810 / 5910; ibipimo by'umwimerere birabikwa.
settings.appearance_subtitle: Hitamo uburyo bw'umucyo cyangwa ubw'ijoro kuri ecran zose za JENESIS
settings.theme_dark_desc: Ahakorerwa hijimye, heza mu gihe cy'akazi karekare
settings.theme_applies_now: Insanganyamatsiko ihita ikoreshwa ako kanya, nta gufunga porogaramu.
settings.theme_persist_note: Icyo wahisemo kibikwa kuri iyi mudasobwa kandi kigakomeza no nyuma yo gufunga no kongera gufungura JENESIS.

auth.login_intro: Andika izina ry’ukoresha n’ijambobanga rya JENESIS.
auth.setup_intro: Shyiraho ikigo n’konti ya mbere y’umuyobozi. Iyi ntambwe ikorwa rimwe gusa.
auth.change_password_intro: Ugomba guhindura ijambobanga mbere yo gukoresha JENESIS.
auth.unavailable_title: JENESIS ntibashije kugera kuri serivisi yayo y’imbere
auth.unavailable_intro: Serivisi y’ibaruramari ntiyasubije. Funga JENESIS wongere uyitangire. Niba ikibazo gikomeje, reba dosiye y’amateka mu bubiko bwa JENESIS.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Nta burenganzira ufite bwo gukora iki gikorwa.
errors.COMPANY_FORBIDDEN: Nta burenganzira ufite bwo kugera kuri iki kigo.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Izina ry’ukoresha cyangwa ijambobanga si byo.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Konti yafunzwe by’agateganyo kubera ko hagerageje inshuro nyinshi zitatsinze. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
errors.PASSWORD_MATCHES_USERNAME: Ijambobanga ntirigomba kuba rimwe n’izina ry’ukoresha.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SIMPLE: Ijambobanga ntirigomba kuba inyuguti imwe isubirwamo.
errors.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Ugomba guhindura ijambobanga mbere yo gukomeza.
errors.USERNAME_INVALID: Izina ry’ukoresha rigomba kuba inyuguti 3–40: inyuguti, imibare, akadomo, akarongo cyangwa umurongo wo hasi.
errors.SELF_LOCKOUT: Ntushobora gukuraho uburenganzira bwawe bw’umuyobozi cyangwa guhagarika konti yawe.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: Hagomba gusigara nibura umuyobozi umwe ukora.
errors.RESET_DISABLED: Gusubiza ububiko ku ntangiriro binyuze mu nteruro byahagaritswe. Koresha kopi y’ubwizigame no kuyisubiza.
errors.NO_COMPANY: Nta kigo kibaho. Ongera utangire JENESIS kugira ngo ububiko butangizwe.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Ububiko ntibuhagije kuri iki gikorwa. Reba ingano ihari kuri buri duka.
errors.ALREADY_POSTED: Iyi nyandiko yamaze kwinjizwa mu ibaruramari. Kwinjiza kabiri ntibyemewe.
errors.NOTHING_TO_REVERSE: Nta nyandiko y’ibaruramari yo gukuraho kuri iyi nyandiko.
errors.FULLY_CREDITED: Iyi fagitire yamaze gusubizwa yose. Ntabwo wasubiza kabiri.
errors.OVER_RETURN: Ingano usubiza iruta ingano isigaye isubizwa kuri iyi fagitire.
errors.OVER_REFUND: Iri subiza ryarenza amafaranga fagitire yemera.
errors.CN_NEEDS_POSTED_INVOICE: Inyandiko yo gusubiza ikorwa gusa kuri fagitire yamaze kwinjizwa.
errors.WALKIN_IMMEDIATE_PAYMENT: Ibyagurishijwe kuri walk-in bigomba kwishyurwa ako kanya. Ku ideni, koresha umukiriya uzwi.
errors.NO_CASH_ACCOUNT: Nta kese ikora yagenwe ku bicuruzwa bya walk-in.
errors.GRN_REQUIRED: Iyi sosiyete isaba inyandiko yo kwakira yinjiye mbere yo kwinjiza fagitire y’umugemura. Banza wakire ibicuruzwa, ubihuze na fagitire.
errors.GRN_NOT_POSTED: Inyandiko yo kwakira ifitanye isano ntiyarinjizwa.
errors.OVER_RECEIPT: Kwakira kurengeje ibyatumijwe cyangwa ibyamaze kwakirwa.
errors.PO_CANCELLED: Ntabwo wakwakira ibicuruzwa kuri komande yaseswe.
errors.NOTHING_TO_RECEIVE: Nta cyo kwakira: imirongo yose yamaze kwakirwa yuzuye.
errors.SERVICE_NOT_STOCKABLE: Ibicuruzwa bifatika gusa nibyo byakirwa mu bubiko cyangwa byimurwa hagati y’amaduka (serivisi nta bubiko zigira).
errors.COUNT_SELF_APPROVAL: Ntushobora kwemeza kubara wakoze cyangwa wohereje. Hagomba kwemeza undi muntu wigenga.
errors.CASH_SELF_APPROVAL: Ntushobora kwemeza igenzura rya kese wafunze. Hagomba kwemeza undi muntu wigenga.
errors.COUNT_NOT_SUBMITTED: Kubara kwoherejwe gusa nibyo bishobora kwemezwa cyangwa guhakanwa.
errors.COUNT_NOT_DRAFT: Kubara kw’inyandiko y’iteganywa cyangwa kwahakanwe gusa nibyo bishobora guhindurwa cyangwa koherezwa.
errors.COUNT_NOT_APPROVED: Kubara kwemejwe gusa nibyo bishobora kwinjizwa.
errors.SESSION_ALREADY_OPEN: Igenzura rya kese riracyafunguye kuri iyi konti. Banza urifunge.
errors.SESSION_NOT_CASH_ACCOUNT: Amagenzura ya kese akorwa gusa kuri konti zo mu bwoko bwa KESE.
errors.SESSION_NOT_OPEN: Igenzura rifunguye gusa niryo rishobora gufungwa.
errors.SESSION_NOT_CLOSED: Igenzura ryafunzwe gusa niryo rishobora kwemezwa.
errors.VARIANCE_EXPLANATION_REQUIRED: Ibisobanuro birasabwa iyo amafaranga abazwe atandukanye n’ayateganyijwe.
errors.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Iyi konti ya kese ntabwo ikora.
errors.TRANSFER_SAME_STORE: Iduka ibicuruzwa bivamo n’irijyamo bigomba gutandukana.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_DRAFT: Kwimura kw’inyandiko y’iteganywa gusa nibyo bishobora koherezwa cyangwa guseswa.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_DISPATCHED: Kwimura kwoherejwe (mu nzira) gusa nibyo bishobora kwakirwa.
errors.ALREADY_EXISTS: Hari inyandiko isa nk’iyi isanzwe ihari.
errors.DEFAULT_STORE_LOCKED: Iduka risanzwe ntirishobora gufungwa. Banza uhitamo irindi duka risanzwe.
errors.STORE_HAS_STOCK: Iri duka rikifite ibicuruzwa. Bimure mbere yo kurifunga.
errors.NO_EXCHANGE_RATE: Nta gipimo cy’ivunjisha cyanditswe kuri aya mafaranga kuri iyi tariki.
errors.INVALID_RATE: Igipimo cy’ivunjisha kigomba kuba kiruta zeru.
errors.INVALID_CURRENCY_CODE: Kode y’ifaranga igomba kuba inyuguti 3 (ISO 4217), urugero USD, EUR, RWF.
errors.CURRENCY_NOT_CONFIGURED: Iri faranga ntabwo ryanditswe kuri iyi sosiyete. Ryongere mu Ibyagenwe → Amafaranga.
errors.INVALID_DECIMALS: Imibare nyuma y’akadomo y’ifaranga igomba kuba hagati ya 0 na 4.
errors.INVALID_STORE_CODE: Kode y’iduka igomba kuba inyuguti 2–20: inyuguti, imibare, akadomo, akaruhurirwa cyangwa umurongo wo hasi.
errors.INVALID_DATE: Itariki igomba kuba mu buryo YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.SAME_CURRENCY_PAIR: Igipimo kigomba guhuza amafaranga abiri atandukanye.
errors.UNBALANCED_JOURNAL: Inyandiko y’ibaruramari ntiiringaniye: igiteranyo cya Debite kigomba kungana n’igiteranyo cya Kredite.
errors.CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: Umukiriya arasabwa. Ku kugurisha kw’amafaranga ku muntu utazwi, koresha uburyo bwa walk-in.
errors.FX_SETTLE_REQUIRES_DOCUMENT: Kwishyura ikinyuranyo cy'ivunjisha bisaba inyemezabwishyu cyangwa facture ifitanye isano.
errors.FX_SETTLE_BASE_CURRENCY: Kwishyura ikinyuranyo cy'ivunjisha bisaba kwishyura mu faranga y'amahanga.
errors.FX_ACCOUNTS_MISSING: Konti z'inyungu/igihombo cy'ivunjisha (4800/5900) zirabura kuri iyi sosiyete.
errors.FX_REVALUATION_EXISTS: Ivunjisha ryongeye ryanditswe kuri iyi tariki.
errors.NO_FX_EXPOSURE: Nta mwenda ugaragara mu faranga y'amahanga wo kongera kubara.

shortcuts.escape: Funga agasanduku, hanyuma akanama, hanyuma usubire inyuma (ntisohoka muri JENESIS)
shortcuts.print_none: Nta cyo gucapa kuri iyi paji.

shortcuts.duplicate_none: Hitamo inyandiko mbere, hanyuma ukande Ctrl+D kuyikoporora.

messenger.select_colleague: Hitamo mugenzi wawe kugira ngo utangire

identity.maintenance_purpose: Ububiko, serivisi, urusobe, ubwirinzi, isuzuma no gukemura ibibazo.
identity.admin_purpose: Ibaruramari, kugura, banki, raporo, imisoro, abakoresha, amahitamo n’amateka y’isosiyete.

launcher.title: Hitamo porogaramu ya JENESIS
launcher.intro: JENESIS ni porogaramu eshatu zisangira ibitabo bimwe. Fungura ijyanye n’akazi kawe — uburyo bwo kuri desktop burayifungura.
launcher.remember: Ibuka icyo nahisemo maze ufungure iyi porogaramu ubutaha

maintenance.title: Kubungabunga
maintenance.intro: Imimerere ya JENESIS kuri iyi mudasobwa: serivisi, ububiko, urusobe, ubwirinzi, isuzuma n’inyandiko.
maintenance.allow_lan_hint: Bizimye ubusanzwe: iyi mudasobwa yonyine ni yo igera kuri JENESIS. Bikureho kugira ngo izindi mudasobwa zo ku rusobe rumwe zikoreshe iyi serivisi kandi zohererezanye ubutumwa — Windows izagusaba uburenganzira.
maintenance.disable_lan: Gumisha JENESIS kuri iyi mudasobwa gusa
maintenance.lan_on_restarted: Izindi mudasobwa ku rusobe zishobora kugera kuri JENESIS.
maintenance.lan_off_restarted: JENESIS isubije kuri iyi mudasobwa gusa.
maintenance.restart_needed: Birabitswe. Funga hanyuma wonge gutangiza JENESIS kugira ngo bihinduke.
maintenance.connect_another: Huza iyi mudasobwa n’indi mudasobwa ya JENESIS
maintenance.connect_hint: Siga ubusa kugira ngo ukoreshe JENESIS kuri iyi mudasobwa. Kugira ngo musangire isosiyete n’indi mudasobwa, andika aderesi yayo (igaragara kuri iyo mudasobwa, hano) maze ubanze uyigerageze.
maintenance.test_ok: Serivisi ya JENESIS yasubije kuri iyo aderesi.
maintenance.test_bad: Ikindi kintu cyasubije kuri iyo aderesi.
maintenance.backups_hint: Kopi yemewe ya dosiye yose y’ububiko, ibitswe mu bubiko bwa JENESIS. Yikoporore kuri USB cyangwa mu bubiko bwo ku kicu kugira ngo urindwe by’ukuri.
maintenance.check_problem: Isuzuma ryerekanye ikibazo — garuza ubwirinzi hanyuma ubaze ushinzwe kubungabunga.
